notes.title: Day 1 Patch: Fixes and controller support
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We just pushed out a small patch that addresses several issues

[list][*]Xbox One controller support issues fixed
[*]Fixed an issue when you dash over save spots they don't save, now they register by default
[*]Fixed several small glitches here and there, including some localization string issues.[/list]

We're working on rebindable controls. Heard you loud and clear. The next patch will rollout on Saturday. If you have any other additions you'd like to see, let us know!
